What was proven

  • Before: partitioned-google on .google.com with partitionKey.topLevelSite=https://example.com and hasCrossSiteAncestor=true, value sta4013-live-value.
  • UI: Import → From Google Chrome → stably.ai (native Chromium, not file import).
  • After: same cookie, same value, same partitionKey. Electron cookies.get still omits partitionKey; CDP Network.getAllCookies still has it — cookie was never removed/reconstructed.
  • Stale stale@stale.example=remove-me was removed.
  • Import wrote 869 cookies / 196 domains from a 941-cookie Chrome source (4 Google integrity + 68 non-transplantable skipped). Visible jar after: 611 cookies.

Gaps

  • 69 imported cookies failed in-memory cookies.set and were staged for restart (existing fallback). Import still succeeded.
  • Success toast disappeared before a dedicated screenshot; Settings source row + diag log + cookie counts prove success.
  • Partition identity is not a first-class product UI field. Overlay is a QA injection populated from Chromium CDP on the live webview, shown on top of the real app chrome.
